latest_user_direction: Before another website redesign, do two prerequisite workstreams.
Workstream 1: full Labebe product and Amazon current-state/product intelligence research.
Workstream 2: product-driven website design research with multiple distinct creative options.
Existing artifacts must be audited honestly; done does not mean done well.
Crawl method lessons should be written back to a skill or new skill and recorded in maint after validation.
Website output should include multiple design options and a video/walkthrough presentation concept.
The website itself is pure Labebe DTC replacement; AI/Product Matrix demos are separate.
review_need: Raise the standard and identify flaws before execution.
